item: 7.11 Save as command (a hover control on the prompt bubble asks Kotlin's dialog to keep the text as a /command; the saved echo makes it pickable at once) + 7.12 Recent first (inside a match tier the most recently sent command leads; a sent command is recorded, a refused one is not)
branch: addUserMessage() in js/60-composer.js adds .msg-save; saveAsCommand/onCmdSaved/noteCmdUsed + renderSlash's sort in js/65-slash.js; submit() calls noteCmdUsed; js/70-events.js routes __cmdRecent/__cmdSaved
provenance: `__commands` is ChatPanel's own roster frame (fixture 46's shape; the ' (project)' suffix is the CLI's measured custom marker, 2.1.228); `__cmdRecent` / `__cmdSaved` are ChatPanel.seedUi's and the saveCommand handler's own frames. The bridge is stubbed: nothing here reaches Kotlin or the CLI. Live and replay draw the bubble through the same addUserMessage, so one path stands for both.

steps.note: 0 — a sent prompt gets the save control; a prompt that already is a /command does not

steps.note: 5 — cleanup: real bridge, the page's own roster and recency back
steps.setup: setBusy(false); window.__bridge = window.__realBridge105; slashCommands = markCustom(window.__cmds105.map(function(c){ var o = Object.assign({}, c); if (o.src) { o.description = (o.description || '') + ' (' + o.src + ')'; delete o.src; } return o; })); if (window.__recent105 !== null) { cmdRecent = window.__recent105; } window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({type:'__clear'})); input.value = ''; menuEl('slashMenu').classList.remove('show');
